notes.title: Train Harder 1.5 - Patch note
notes.content:
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
- Added City spawns in Ranked, Time, Secret and Training modes
- Added muzzle smoke fx when firing a pistol

[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
- Improved several Fx including pistol laser, smokes etc ...
- Fixed Secret Mode bug where ennemies won't always spawn
- Fixed left hand "pointing at" model that wasn't displaying correctly when left handed mode was activated

notes.title: Train Harder 1.4 - Patch note
notes.content:
[h1][b]Major Features:[/b][/h1]
- New main menu: Complete rework
- New language added: Chinese (simplified)
- New language added: Russian
- New score menu: Score panel rework
- New music theme

[h1][b]New contents:[/b][/h1]
- Added outline around interactable items when aimed at
- Added sound when passing doors
- Added sound when taking stairs
- Added sound when hiting a target in shooting range
- Added sound when reseting target positions in shooting range
- Added various musics for all game modes
- Added animation when Pistol pop in player's hand
- Added blinking outline to presented polls in tutorial
- Added visual effect showing the area the player must reach to avoid the presented obstacle in tutorial
- Added visual effect showing the area the player must avoid to be in when facing the presented obstacle in tutorial
- Added passing animation to polls when the player succeed to reach the designated area in tutorial
- Added train horning sound before going into motion in tutorial
- Added new text style on scoreboards
- Added animation to labels dropping on scoreboard
- Added rolling score animation on scoreboard
- Added sound fx to scoreboard animations
- Added Chinese and Russian flags

[h1][b]Improvements:[/b][/h1]
- Reworked landscpae design
- Reworked city design
- Improved overall tutorial experience
- Improved Trainer AI textbox
- Updated new music in Ranked Mode
- Updated music in Time Mode
- Improved overall aspect of the score board
- The score board now shows the game mode used when played
- Scoreboard now display negative scores
- A set of musics are now played randomly in Ranked mode
- Added the possibility to pass to the next Trainer dialog by squeezing non primary hand

[h1][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h1]
- Reworked collision hitbox for obstacle with polls on both sides
- Fixed AI trainer bug displaying textbox while moving

notes.title: Train Harder 1.2 - Patch note
notes.content:
Train Harder 1.2 Changelog:

[h1]Major Features[/h1]
- New Game Mode: Time Mode
- New Language added: German
- 5 Secret tips hidden in the world
- Detailed score

[h1]New contents[/h1]
- Added ricochet fix on materials
- Vibration when getting shot and on death
- Social area now has a pianist to entertain you
- Added a controller menu to leave a game at anytime
- Added new animations featuring the secret mode
- Added new musics for game modes

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
- Adjust hand size and position
- Adding multiple sound and voice effects
- Improved sound spatialization
- Music level has been adjusted
- Impacts are now following moving targets
- Bottles are now responding to physics correctly and can be shot
- Increase base speed in Secret mode
- Overall Secret mode experience has been improved

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where avatars where not downloaded on leader-boards
- Fixed inverted cross selection in option menu
- Fixed holding position with interactive items
- Removed laser from pistol when in shooting range
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Train Harder 1.1 - Patch note
notes.content:
Train Harder 1.1 Changelog:

[h1]Major Features[/h1]
- New Game Mode: Customizable Training Mode
- New Language added: French
- Improved hit  detection, removing unfair collisions
- Tutorial does not force the player to do squats anymore

[h1]New contents[/h1]
- Added laser to the pistol as helper in the menu
- Added protection against wall-walking
- Added new dialog to Trainer-AI
- Added new animations to Trainer-AI
- Added panel showing the shooting range inside the tutorial building

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
- Improved Trainer-AI model
- Improved Trainer-AI animations

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- Fixed the way an option is selected when there is multiple choices
- Fixed the position of the area inside the tutorial building
- Fixed time achievement not achievable during tutorial anymore
